issues.where: crop 11, the top edge of the distant tan plain under the sun, running the full width
issues.what: a thin dark, jagged, aliased line runs along the top of the far plain like the edge of a cut-out card; the plain reads as a flat flat-coloured strip pasted between sky and field
issues.fix: remove the outline/seam on the backdrop mesh, antialias the edge, and let haze and sun glow cross the edge so the plain blends into the sky

issues.where: crop 10 and crop 11, the far field just below the plain
issues.what: the field ends in a hard straight horizontal line against a featureless tan/brown band; a visible line where detail changes from instanced flowers to a flat card
issues.fix: continue sparse, ever-smaller flower instances up to the horizon and fade them out with distance fog instead of a hard cut

issues.where: crop 10, the dark hills on the skyline
issues.what: the hills are a single flat near-black silhouette with a blobby, regular outline and no aerial-perspective layering; they read as a cut-out picture
issues.fix: give the ridges depth with several layers that lighten and turn bluer with distance, and an irregular profile with some tree texture

issues.where: crops 3, 4, 5, 6: the leaves of both hero plants
issues.what: the leaves are a single desaturated grey-blue green with a waxy sheen, they look like flat cards with a bright painted rim, and no light passes through them even with the sun behind (crop 5 shows no translucency or glowing veins)
issues.fix: add subsurface/translucency so backlit leaves glow yellow-green, vary hue per leaf, add vein relief and some cupping and thickness

issues.what: the stems are smooth tubes with a single thin bright rim line; no hairs are seen against the backlight
issues.fix: add fine stem hair geometry or fur that catches the backlight as a soft fuzzy halo

issues.where: crop 9 and crop 1, the field behind the plant
issues.what: the background heads are near-identical copies, all the same size, all facing the lens at the same angle in an even scatter, with the same leaf silhouette repeated down the rows
issues.fix: vary head size, tilt, facing, petal count and plant height per instance, and add some plants that droop or have buds

issues.where: crop 6, the base of both hero stems
issues.what: the stems vanish into the grass with no clear contact shadow or soil at the base; the plants feel slightly placed on top of the ground
issues.fix: add ambient occlusion and a soft contact shadow and a little visible soil where each stem enters the ground

issues.where: crop 1, the petals of the hero heads
issues.what: the petals are uniform in length and shape and evenly spaced, with clean smooth edges and little sign of curl or damage
issues.fix: randomise petal length, width, curl and spacing and add a few bent or torn petals

issues.what: the grass is a dense even carpet of identical blades with dry tufts set out in regular diagonal bands
issues.fix: break up the instancing with clumps, bare soil patches, varied blade height and colour
